description: Ranged weapon and Serpent Wards. Banks Spirit off Reclamation into Spirit Eclipse, shuts a target off with Spirit Shock and Hex of Death, and carries party auras on a shamanic chassis.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_witch-doctor__shadowhunting.txt and the 'shadowhunting' tree in reference/coa_sidekick/talents/witch-doctor.json. CoA: 'Closest to a Survival Hunter built on a shamanic support chassis ... Mechanically it's a support-flavored chassis that was talented into being a real ranged-hybrid combatant, spending most of its buttons on Spirit-fueled ranged damage rather than on healing.' Its stat priority is Attack Power > Crit > Agility > Intellect/Spirit > Spell Power, which is why this is the one Witch Doctor tree that spends on attack power and physical crit at all, and why Sen'jin's Apprentice - which pays Intellect into ranged attack power and Agility into spell damage - is its keystone. Its stated weakness is CC: 'Shadowstalker wipes harmful effects on its own timer and that is the entire answer to CC', and nothing in this tree pretends otherwise.

nodes.name: Loa's Strength
nodes.description: Increases your Agility by 2% and the Nature and Shadow damage you deal by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Agility and your Nature and Shadow damage dealt by 3%' at 2 ranks. nature_shadow_damage_pct is a combined school key - the engine resolves it per underscore component against the real school set, so it covers both.

nodes.name: Improved Malefic Arrow
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Malefic Arrow by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Malefic Arrow by -2 sec' at 2 ranks. Malefic Arrow is already on a 2-turn cooldown here, which a flat reduction would erase entirely, so the node pays throughput instead.

nodes.name: Village Wisdom
nodes.description: Increases your hit chance by 1% and the damage of Reclamation by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your hit chance by 5% and the damage of Reclamation by 15%.' Both halves, per rank.

nodes.name: Shadowhunter
nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of all your abilities by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Allows you to auto shoot with a ranged weapon. In addition, reduces the mana cost of all spells and abilities by -25%.' Auto-shoot already exists for every class through data/abilities/_universal.json, so the cost cut is the live half. POSITIVE is the discount here - talented_cost does cost * (1 - pct).

nodes.name: Sen'jin's Apprentice
nodes.description: Grants ranged attack power equal to 2% of your Intellect and spell damage equal to 2% of your Agility, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your ranged attack power by 100% of your Intellect and your ranged attack power and spell power by 25% of your Agility.' Two real stat conversions, and the reason CoA says 'your shots scale off both'.

nodes.name: Spiritual Devotee
nodes.description: Increases your maximum Mana by 2% and restores 2 Mana every 5 seconds, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Collecting a Spirit now instantly restores 3% of your maximum mana.' Spirits are not a resource here (see the module docstring), so the refund becomes a real pool and a real regen rate.

nodes.name: Shadow Enchantments
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Hex of Malice by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the duration and effectiveness of your Jinxes by 25%' at 2 ranks. Hex of Malice is the Jinx this spec actually keeps rolling.

nodes.name: Eye of Kimbul
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank, with both weapons and spells.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes now apply Eye of Kimbul to enemies. Increases damage dealt and critical strike chance against this target by 1%, stacking 5 times.' Crit is second in this spec's stat priority and its damage is split between ranged weapon and spells, so the node covers both.

nodes.name: Spirit Hunting
nodes.description: Your damaging abilities have a 25% chance to restore 20 Mana, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each active Spirit gives you a 15% chance when you cast Malefic Arrow to generate an additional Spirit.' A Spirit is health and Mana back, so the proc grants Mana.

nodes.name: Berserking
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Periodic damage dealt now has a 25% chance to increase the haste of your Serpent Wards by 3% for 15 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.' Wards are not separate actors here, so the haste is yours.

nodes.name: Godslayer
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Spirit Glaive by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Spirit Glaive now deals an additional shadow damage to up to 5 nearby enemies at the end of its duration.'

nodes.name: Hex of Death
nodes.description: Your damaging abilities cut the healing the target receives by 6% per rank for three turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Malefic Arrow now reduces the targets healing received by -20% for 10 seconds, stacking 2 times'; 'Hex of Death cuts a target's healing received via Malefic Arrow. You shut a target off, not just damage it.' healing_taken_pct inside a status effect takes percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: The True Spirit
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Spirit Eclipse by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Summoning a Serpent Ward or Spirit now increases the damage of your next Spirit Glaive or Spirit Eclipse by 6% for 10 seconds, stacking 5 times.' The stacking condition has no hook; the 6% is real.

nodes.name: Serpent's Guile
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Nature damage-over-time effects by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Malefic Arrow now deals an additional 15% of its damage dealt every 1 sec for 4 seconds as Nature damage.' Adding a DoT to a direct-damage ability is not expressible, so the node scales the Nature DoTs the spec already has - Call of Sseratus above all.

nodes.name: Voodoo Fire
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Call of Sseratus by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Serpent Ward's attacks now have a 20% chance to shoot Voodoo Fire, dealing Fire damage to up to 3 nearby enemies' at 2 ranks, plus 'Spirit Striker - Increases the proc chance of Voodoo Fire by 10%.' Two nodes' worth of ward damage, folded into one.

nodes.name: Umbral Glaive
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Spirit Glaive by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: CoA ships Umbral Glaive with no tooltip ('see builder tooltip'), but the rotation says what it does: 'Keep Hex of Malice rolling with Umbral Glaive. Its glaive refreshes Hex of Malice's duration and leeches health, so you re-up the dot without re-casting it.' A refresh-on-hit has no hook, so more glaives is the honest version.

nodes.name: Strength of Da Loa
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the attack power of party and raid members by 5%.' GAP: a talent reaches its owner only, so the party half is lost. Attack power still matters here - it leads this spec's stat priority, ahead of Agility.

nodes.name: Darkspear Traditionalist
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 1 and all damage you deal by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Emanate a powerful aura, granting 10% increased melee and ranged haste to party and raid members.' Same party-reach gap as Strength of Da Loa above.

nodes.name: Bwonsamdi's Edge
nodes.description: Increases the damage your abilities deal to additional targets by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Spirit Eclipse now deals 40% increased damage when it explodes on impact' - the explosion is what hits the enemies around the target.

nodes.name: Dambala's Lethality
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike damage by 4% per rank, with both weapons and spells.
nodes._source: CoA: 'After using Spirit Eclipse, the damage of your next Shadowflare within 15 seconds is increased by 50%.' A one-cast window off another cast has no hook, so the node becomes burst of the kind the spec can actually keep - crit damage, on both of its damage types.

nodes.name: A Price To Pay
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 30% chance to reset the cooldown of Spirit Glaive, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Spirit Eclipse with 5 Spirits now resets the cooldown of Spirit Glaive and causes your next cast within 8 seconds to be guaranteed to critically strike.' reset_cooldown is a real proc payload, so the reset half is literal; the guaranteed crit is not expressible, so the proc fires off crits instead of granting one.

nodes.name: Viper Ward
nodes.description: Increases the Fire damage you deal by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Transforms Call of Sseratus into Viper Ward ... Viper Wards have a 50% chance to unleash a Hexfire Blast, dealing Fire damage to an enemy.' Replacing one ability with another needs an unlock_ability and a second ward spell; the Fire damage the transformation is for is the honest single-node version.

nodes.name: Frenzied Spirits
nodes.description: You spend every spirit you were carrying at once.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Consumes your Spirits to increase your ranged critical strike rating by 10, critical damage by 5%, and causing you to heal for 2% of all damage dealt for each Spirit consumed.' The leech half is already on the ability of the same name, so the talent carries the crit.
